svg.title: How a railfs mount happens
svg.desc: Three columns. Left, the call chain: mount.railfs folds HOST:EXPORT into one option string and calls mount(2); init_fs_context allocates a railfs_options on the fs_context, parse_param fills it, get_tree_nodev allocates an anonymous super_block, and fill_super builds the root and dials the peer. Middle, the objects each step touches. Right, the connection pool that opts->pool points at, and the raild it talks to over a TCP control channel and RDMA data rails.
